question_papers.paper_title: Set 1 - Measurement of Time and Motion (NCERT Standard Practice Set)

sections.section_name: Section B (Short Answer Questions - 3 Marks Each)

questions.question_text: Differentiate between uniform motion and non-uniform motion.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Uniform Motion: Object travels equal distances in equal time intervals along a straight line. Non-uniform Motion: Object travels unequal distances in equal time intervals.

questions.question_text: Describe the practical activity with aim: 'To measure and verify the constancy of a simple pendulum's time period.'. Outline key steps and conclusion.
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
Steps: Set up pendulum suspended from clamp stand., Displace bob 5 cm to one side from mean position and release gently., Measure total time for 20 complete oscillations using stopwatch., Calculate Time Period T = Total Time / 20.
Conclusion: The time period of a simple pendulum of fixed length is constant (isochronous periodic motion).

sections.section_name: Section C (Long Answer & Case Study - 5 Marks Each)

questions.question_text: Explain simple pendulum construction, define mean position, extreme position, amplitude, oscillation, and time period, and compute time period if 20 oscillations take 42 seconds.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Simple pendulum: Metallic bob on light string. 1. Mean position: Central equilibrium point when stationary. 2. Extreme position: Maximum displacement point. 3. Amplitude: Maximum distance from mean position. 4. Oscillation: Complete movement from mean to extreme A, extreme B, and back to mean. 5. Time Period T = Total time / Number of oscillations = 42 s / 20 = 2.1 seconds.

questions.question_text:
Case Scenario: A car odometer reads 57321.0 km at 08:30 AM and 57336.0 km at 08:50 AM.
Question: Find the distance traveled and car speed in km/min and km/h.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Distance = 57336.0 - 57321.0 = 15 km. Time elapsed = 20 minutes (1/3 hour). Speed in km/min = 15 / 20 = 0.75 km/min. Speed in km/h = 15 / (1/3) = 45 km/h.

questions.question_text: Outline the procedure and observations for investigating Measurement of Time and Motion in the laboratory.
questions.marking_scheme_answer:
Procedure: Set up pendulum suspended from clamp stand., Displace bob 5 cm to one side from mean position and release gently., Measure total time for 20 complete oscillations using stopwatch., Calculate Time Period T = Total Time / 20.
Observations: Total time for 20 oscillations remains nearly identical across multiple trials (~40 seconds for 1m length, T = 2.0 s).
